title: New ideas, new names, old references
author: Ani Chaudhuri
dek: Every founder who builds something genuinely new meets the same problem on the first day they try to explain it. You need a name.
description: Every founder who builds something genuinely new meets the same problem on the first day they try to explain it. You need a name.
cover_alt: New ideas, new names, old references. Horseless carriage, struck out: car. Wireless telegraph, struck out: radio. Paper ledger sheet, struck out: spreadsheet. AI-ready metadata, struck out: pearl. A single pearl rests on the sea floor in shafts of light.

title: AI's SpaceX moment
author: Ani Chaudhuri
dek: Reusable rockets changed the economics of space. AI still flies single-use. It hasn't had its SpaceX moment yet.
description: Reusable rockets changed the economics of space. AI still flies single-use. It hasn't had its SpaceX moment yet.

title: Why SeaSand Exists
author: Ani Chaudhuri
dek: The world needs people and machines to work as partners. SeaSand exists to build that.
dek2: You get the why and the how today. The what comes later.
description: The world needs people and machines to work as partners. SeaSand exists to build that.
